name: x402 CLI Access with radius-cli 0.2.0
query: Access this Radius Testnet x402 endpoint once from the terminal. I have a funded local radius-cli wallet. Do not create a Node project.
context: The endpoint speaks x402 and the user wants a one-off unattended terminal flow.
expected_behavior: Checks for radius-cli version 0.2.0 or later
Uses radius-cli wallet x402 instead of the low-level curl/cast fallback
Sets RADIUS_HOME to a project-scoped directory and RADIUS_NETWORK=testnet
Uses --json and -y only after the URL and threshold are explicit
Explains that -y does not override the threshold and an above-cap offer is refused with exit code 2
Does not pass a raw private key as a command-line argument
success_criteria: Command shape is radius-cli wallet x402 <verb> <url>
The threshold is described as a per-request hard cap rather than a total budget
The answer does not claim the user needs native RUSD when the Radius facilitator sponsors Permit2 approval
The legacy curl/cast reference is not used for the ordinary CLI request
